justification: The AI reader's chunk-loss guard refused whole chapters when a 12-page batch held only contents pages and narrative history: Leichhardt part-c-s2 twice (31,028 characters, not one control). It now weighs only pages that can hold a rule. Critical because this guard is what stops a chapter losing pages silently (marrickville, 94 pages).

pre_impl.existing_data: No database. Measured the refused pages from the PDF: pages 1-5 contents (38-46 of ~40 lines end in a page number), 6-12 suburb profiles with no rule language.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed an empty answer for a text-heavy batch meant loss. For contents and narrative it is the correct answer; the guard could not tell the two apart.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Replaces _chunk_text_chars (now unused, removed) with _chunk_rule_chars in the same guard; unreadable pages still count in full.
pre_impl.external_source_error: A page pypdf cannot read counts as rule-bearing, so the guard still errs toward reporting loss.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend change: this only decides whether an extraction batch is refused before anything is queued.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: If rule language were missed on a real controls page, a lost batch could pass. Mitigated: broad rule vocabulary; the marrickville-shape test still raises; a mutation removing the filter fails two tests.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a batch of rule-bearing pages that returns nothing does not raise ChunkLoss, or a batch of contents/history pages does
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before: leichhardt part-c-s2 refused twice at pages 1-12. Removing the new filter fails 2 tests.

functions.name: ai_extractor._chunk_rule_chars
functions.input: The pypdf reader for the chapter and a page range [a, b) of one batch sent to the model.
functions.output: Characters on pages in the range that are not contents pages and carry rule language, which the guard weighs.
functions.if_none: A page pypdf cannot read counts as CHUNK_LOSS_MIN_TEXT_CHARS, so unreadable pages still trip the guard.

functions.name: ai_extractor._is_contents_page
functions.input: The extracted text of one PDF page, split into its non-empty lines for the page-number check.
functions.output: True when at least eight lines exist and half or more of them end in a page number, as a contents page does.
functions.if_none: Empty or short text returns False, so the page falls through to the rule-language check instead.

values.name: contents share
values.value: >= 50% of >= 8 lines end in a digit
values.why: Leichhardt part-c-s2 contents pages measured 38-46 of 39-49 lines.

break_it.scenario: A batch of real control pages returns nothing from the model because of a provider fault
break_it.what_happens: The chapter would be committed missing those pages, the marrickville failure.
break_it.how: Control pages carry rule language, so they are weighed; the marrickville-shape test still raises ChunkLoss.

break_it.scenario: A batch holds only the chapter's contents pages and returns nothing, correctly
break_it.what_happens: The whole chapter was refused and never updated, as Leichhardt part-c-s2 was twice.
break_it.how: Contents pages are excluded from the weight before the threshold is applied.

break_it.scenario: A batch holds narrative history with no controls and returns nothing, correctly
break_it.what_happens: Same refusal: text-heavy pages with no rule looked like loss.
break_it.how: Pages without rule language are excluded from the weight.

break_it.scenario: A page pypdf cannot read sits in an empty batch among other pages
break_it.what_happens: If treated as blank it would hide real loss behind an unreadable page.
break_it.how: An unreadable page counts in full toward the threshold, as before.

break_it.scenario: A chunk mixes contents pages with real controls and returns nothing at all
break_it.what_happens: The contents exclusion must not hide the controls it sits beside.
break_it.how: Only contents and rule-free pages are excluded; the controls' characters still count and exceed the threshold.

post_merge.manual_verify: Re-read leichhardt/part-c-s2-urban-character: it must enqueue, not raise ChunkLoss at pages 1-12.
